reviewMethod: Phase 2.5: inspected four neutral angles, face close-up, 16 desktop clip samples, and exact optimized desktop/mobile GLBs decoded and rendered in Blender. Mobile pose review and software checks reported separately. No browser validation is implied.
notes: Female Bornean educational model remains simplified, without cheek flanges; no imported animal geometry, new species, layout or viewer-control changes.
Shorter surface-following groom reduces stray hair; face has subtle exported pigment folds and revised nasal/brow contours. Mobile preserves half of the groom with one triangle per ordinary strand.

Walk separates 64% support and 36% recovery phases. Climb uses fixed virtual wrist targets; source contact test over 151 frames measures maximum target error under 0.8mm. This does not validate contact with a real branch or anatomical biomechanics.
All 16 desktop pose samples have no vertices below ground beyond 5mm. Four views and optimized exports retain separated limbs and fingers. Appearance is stylized, not photorealistic.
The browser rendering, touchscreen, clipboard, Close/Back and GPU performance tests remain unavailable and unverified.
